description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a product engineering team building a platform and marketplace for reinforcement learning environments. You will combine product judgment, interaction design, and full-stack engineering to make complex workflows clearer for environment creators and AI research teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work with product, design, engineering, research, and go-to-market partners to identify user friction and prioritize improvements.

 - Speak directly with users to understand challenges in creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering reinforcement learning environments.

 - Own product improvements from problem definition and prototyping through implementation, launch, and iteration.

 - Build frontend and backend features for onboarding, environment submission, review, and discovery workflows.

 - Design interfaces that help users understand agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback.

 - Use user feedback and product data to refine experiences and inform tradeoffs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience shipping software products end-to-end, from understanding user needs through implementation and iteration.

 - A technical degree and full-stack web application experience, including polished frontend interfaces and backend services or APIs.

 - Experience interviewing users and using qualitative feedback and product data to improve shipped products.

 - Strong interaction design and product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows and making decisions with incomplete information.

 - Background in developer tools, data-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct user groups.

 - Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or workflows involving review, debugging, and quality feedback.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $100,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Remote candidates are welcome, with 70% to 80% time zone overlap required with San Francisco or Singapore. Office locations are available in San Francisco and Singapore.
